confirmations.why: The sentence tells the model to write a commit message that says what changed, which fits an imperative subject under 60 characters followed by the why, and it doesn't forbid or require anything that contradicts the rule.

The sentence tells the model to dispatch subagents with an explicit model (`claude-haiku-5-5`), which overrides the model their definition pins, and the reader rule forbids that override on the dispatch call.

The sentence permits dispatching `claude-haiku-5-5` subagents, which names a model on the dispatch call and overrides whatever model each subagent definition pins, which rule 6 forbids, and it sets no limit such as 'only for agents that pin no model'.

The sentence gives unlimited permission to repeat an action on the model's own judgement, which could include destructive actions that the rule says need explicit go-ahead in the conversation, and it has no limit such as 'only if not destructive'.

The sentence lets the reviewer retry a refused action on its own judgement with no limit, which could include destructive actions the reader rule forbids without explicit go-ahead in the conversation.
The sentence tells the model to dispatch subagents on an explicit model (`claude-haiku-5-5`), which overrides the model their definitions pin, and the rule forbids overriding it on the dispatch call.
The sentence tells the model to dispatch subagents explicitly on `claude-haiku-5-5`, which overrides the model the subagent definitions pin, and the rule forbids overriding it on the dispatch call.
The sentence dispatches a Haiku subagent, which sets the model on the dispatch call (overriding the model the definition pins), and rule 6 forbids that override.

The sentence only adds a restriction on content (no agent, session or roster names) and does not contradict the rule's imperative subject under 60 characters followed by why, so it is stricter than or compatible with the reader rule.

The sentence tells the model to dispatch subagents on "the cheapest capable model your host offers," which means choosing a model on the dispatch call, and the rule says to leave the model to the definition's pin and not override it.
